swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A mixture of hydrogen and oxygen gas is classified as homogeneous. Reason (R): gas particles are free to move in all directions, so they mix easily and uniformly with other gases.

add.q: Assertion (A): A mixture of hydrogen and oxygen gas is classified as homogeneous. Reason (R): This is because hydrogen and oxygen react chemically with each other at room temperature to form a single new uniform substance. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Sublimation can be used to separate camphor from sand. Reason (R): camphor changes directly from solid to vapour on heating, while sand does not.

add.q: Assertion (A): Sublimation can be used to separate camphor from sand. Reason (R): Crystallization is based on the difference in solubility of substances at different temperatures. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
